def join_parts(mine: str, theirs: str) -> str:
    """Joins the two read results with a bar separator."""
    ex join_parts("a", "b") == "a|b"
    ex join_parts("", "") == "|"
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Reads path and a fixed sibling file through the capability it is given."""
    ex join_parts("", "") == "|"
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return join_parts(mine=mine, theirs=theirs)

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Runs plugin(path) with fs narrowed to the notes directory, so reads outside notes return ""."""
    pre path.char_count() > 0
    post out.char_count() >= 1
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path=path)
